title: acer hyrcanum subsp. keckianum
intro: Acer hyrcanum subsp. keckianum, commonly known as the Keck's Caucasian maple, is a deciduous maple tree native to the Caucasus region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to regulate blood pressure and prevent atherosclerosis. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective properties, making Keck's Caucasian maple a valuable resource for traditional medicine and pharmaceutical applications.
